0022600155.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak, 15th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-4, on a three-game losing streak, 12th in the East) in a game that is the Nets' sixth of the season. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest; 10.3 points and 22.6 minutes per game this season), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The Nets trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 136-109 in Brooklyn on October 25, and they lost their 2025-26 series with Indiana 1-2.
